title: Kissed by the Sun Australian Chicken Stir Fry
description: A fusion of Indian and Australian flavors, this stir fry is a perfect blend of spices and freshness.

ingredients.name: Kissed by the Sun Australian Chicken

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the pan and cook until tender.
Add the stir fry sauce, soy sauce, honey, garam masala, sugar, salt, and black pepper to the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Return the chicken to the pan and stir to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the chicken is coated and the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
